announcements.title: Building Agentic AI using IBM Tools - 18th Nov, Tuesday, 2-4 PM
announcements.content:
Hello everyone,
Here is another exciting opportunity to learn Agentic AI building using IBM tools.
Register Now!
Nov 18th, 2-4 PM at Canada Life Village Square (F1027/F1029), Innovation Village
Hands-on Workshop: Building Agents with watsonx Orchestrate
Learning Objectives
By the end of this session, you’ll be able to:
Understand what watsonx Orchestrate is and how it works
Build agents without writing any code
Integrate tools and knowledge bases into your agents
Create agentic RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) solutions
Use external tools like Firecrawl for web scraping
Govern Agents
This is a hands-on session, so don’t forget to bring your laptop!
It’s also a fantastic chance to meet industry experts from IBM and gain insights into their expectations.

announcements.title: An Exciting Opportunity for Students Passionate About STEM – With TCS
announcements.content:
Hello,
Looking to kickstart your career and connect with industry leaders? Here’s your chance to prove your skills and get a fair chance to get interviewed and identified for Internship/Co-op or Full Time Opportunities.
Register now for TCS CodeVita Season 13 - https://codevita.tcsapps.com/
🎁 Exclusive Benefits: USD 20,000 cash prize, Certificates, global rankings, and gift vouchers for participants and winners, Top Women coder Awards!
🎁 Perks for Early Birds: The first 100 participants to register will receive exciting gift vouchers!
🎁 Meet the Experts: Get a unique opportunity to interact with top industry professionals at the Networking event and gain insights for your career.
Don’t miss out – your journey to innovation, networking, and prizes starts here!
Registration deadline: October 3 , 2025
1. Sign up here: https://codevita.tcsapps.com/
2. Total Time to register at platform: 60 seconds
3. Link for Instructions: https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7361230268369727488/
4. Award ceremony  of season 12- https://youtube.com/live/vCanLT7aT_U?si=DDIZqRhYP5iOLp-b
In addition, you are invited to join a variety of engaging events, including networking sessions, lucky draws, and interview opportunities. These experiences are designed to give you valuable insights and connections in the STEM industry.
PLEASE make use of this opportunity and kindly reach out to me if you have any questions or need guidance!
Happy to help :)
-Magdalene
